--- grant_on_all_tables_in_quoted_default_schema.sql
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA `DEFAULT` TO ROLE role1

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnAllTablesInSchema{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.SelectPrivilege{
        Select: 6,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
    },
    Default: -1,
    Schemas: []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 37,
            NameEnd: 46,
            Name:    "DEFAULT",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 55,
      NameEnd: 60,
      Name:    "role1",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA `DEFAULT` TO ROLE role1
